title: S&P 500 and Dow Enter Correction, Nasdaq Erases 2026 Gain as AI Selloff Sends Yields Sharply Lower
detail: The S&P 500 and Dow each closed about 10% below recent highs, and the Nasdaq Composite turned negative for the year, as investors took profits in AI stocks after the Anthropic IPO and worried about the AI investment wave. Treasuries rallied on safe-haven demand: the 10-year fell 12bp to 4.932%, the 2-year fell over 14bp to 4.634% and the 30-year fell over 8bp to 5.316%. Despite the growth scare, CME FedWatch still priced about a 92% chance of a 25bp December hike, and Philadelphia Fed's Paulson said further tightening lies ahead. University of Michigan sentiment rose to 51.5 in November from 48.0.

media.caption: Markets plunge: Nasdaq erases 2026 gains, S&P and Dow enter corrections
